name: 16242 · New Bethlehem, PA
findings: ZIP 16242 (New Bethlehem) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16242 (New Bethlehem) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16242 (New Bethlehem) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
